about_the_game:
Early Access launch price at $3.99 - Full movie coming soon at $9.99!

Dive into the depths of suspense with Sharkarma, the first cinematic-grade CG short film designed exclusively for 6-Degrees-of-Freedom (6DoF) VR. Directed by Cinzia Angelini and powered by the Lumiere-award-winning V-Nova PresenZ format, Sharkarma blends visual immersion with a grounded warning message on the ripple-effects (karma) of bad actions.

The project is developed with the support of conservation partners including WildAid, Wendy Benchley (wife of Peter Benchley, author of Jaws), Stop Finning EU, Diane Warren Foundation, and benefits from technical collaboration with Lenovo.

The over 20-minute CG movie follows marine explorer Dr. Karam Mana as he uncovers a brutal shark-finning operation during a deep-sea mysterious expedition. But in the shadows of the Pacific, something ancient awakens to restore balance.

Key Features

  • Immersive VR cinematography: the film uses the revolutionary V-Nova PresenZ format to deliver offline ray-traced 6DoF visuals, allowing viewers to move freely within smooth scenes with realistic physics, lighting and complexity that go beyond what real-time game engines would be able to achieve.

  • Narrative-driven experience: follow a story that mixes marine environments with mystery and thrilling action.

  • Ocean conservation twist: the fictional experience touches on real-world issues like shark finning and the destruction of marine ecosystems, with input from environmental organizations.

  • From discovery to danger: Part 1 introduces the world and sets the tone with a sense of wonder and growing tension. With the full movie release, the story will take a darker turn, delivering intense, suspenseful  sequences that aren’t for the faint of heart.

Pricing – Support Early, Save Big

Sharkarma is being released in two stages: early access and final movie. By purchasing now in early access at discount, you're not only getting Part 1 immediately, but also securing access to the full movie at no extra cost when it is completed later in 2025.

You will also have access to bonus content, webinars with the Director and the production team, and possibly even influence with your feedback some of the final stages of production.

Here’s how it works:

  • $3.99 – Early Access launch price
    Get Part 1 immediately, plus:

    • Automatic access to the full movie (Parts 1 + 2) when ready 

    • Exclusive behind-the-scenes videos, interviews, and bonus content

    • Be part of shaping Part 2 with community feedback, sneak
      previews and webinars.

  • $9.99 – Full Movie price

    After the final movie is released, the full experience (Part 1 + 2) will be
    available at its standard price.

You only pay once. Buying early means a relevant Early Access discount and unlocking exclusive extras along the way, while supporting us at shaping the future of VR storytelling.

Awards

The V-Nova PresenZ format has won three Lumiere Awards from Hollywood’s Advanced Imaging Society, recognizing its groundbreaking visual fidelity and its potential to unlock the future of immersive VR storytelling.

Useful Information

For ImmersiX manual, contact form, and privacy policy, please refer to the ‘View the Manual’ link on the ImmersiX App page.

Stay tuned on the Sharkarma website for the full movie release date and extra bonus content!

content_descriptors.notes: Includes frightening scenes; psychological horror along with violent and gory content

name: ImmersiX - Sharkarma
short_description: Sharkarma tells the story of six friends, a vast ocean and a seriously big shark. It also opens a new chapter in cinematic storytelling technology.
